description: This file defines the InBinary class, which represents a binary 'in' expression node in Twig's abstract syntax tree. It handles compilation of the 'in' operation within Twig templates, specifically compiling it into PHP code that calls CoreExtension::inFilter.

classes.name: InBinary
classes.description: Represents an 'in' binary expression node in Twig's syntax tree, responsible for compiling the 'in' operator into executable PHP code.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the 'in' binary expression into PHP code by calling CoreExtension::inFilter with the left and right nodes as arguments.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string 'in' representing the binary operator this node models.
